info.bio:
Spandau Ballet fue una banda popular inglesa de los años 80. Inicialmente inspirada por una mezcla de funk y synthpop, el grupo eventualmente cambiara su estilo al pop. Asimismo como sus rivales de Duran Duran, ellos conseguirán "estallar" en América, aunque brevemente.

El guitarrista y compositor Gary Kemp, y su hermano, el bajista Martin Kemp formarán la banda en 1979,junto con el baterista John Keeble, el vocalista Tony Hadley y Steve Norman

scenes.name: New romantics y la escena del Blitz
scenes.book: Postpunk. Romper todo y empezar de nuevo
scenes.author: Simon Reynolds
scenes.desc: En el club Billy's y luego el Blitz, Rusty Egan pincha Bowie de Berlín, Iggy, Moroder, Kraftwerk, «Being Boiled», Telex y Yellow Magic Orchestra, y Steve Strange guarda la puerta: maquillaje, sombreros españoles y cortes geométricos, fantasía y escapismo tras ocho horas de trabajo. Visage, superbanda de punks fracasados (Ure, Currie, tres de Magazine), con la tristeza sobrenatural de «Fade to Grey»; Spandau Ballet, elitista y nietzscheano antes de volverse soul; Ultravox reformado con Midge Ure y la glacial «Vienna» (1981). Bowie lo corona con «Ashes to Ashes», con Strange vestido de Pierrot. Martin Rushent, con su sello Genetic, llegó a tenerlos a casi todos.

podcast.body: Spandau Ballet scored their first American hits in 1983, joining other British acts in defining the sound of the second British invasion in the U.S. "Spandau Ballet, Madness, Eddie Grant and Dexys Midnight Runners all scoring their first American hits."

podcast.title: John Hughes Film Exposure (1980s)
podcast.body: Spandau Ballet was among the artists whose music was prominently featured on the meticulously curated soundtracks of John Hughes' 1980s movies. These film soundtracks were instrumental in exposing numerous North American audiences to various alternative rock acts, especially those from the UK. "So many people learned of bands like The Specials and Spandovalet and Billy Idle and General Public and Wang Chung and Yellow and New Order and the Psychedelic Furs and the Smiths and Echo and the Bunyman, Susanne Vagan in excess the Jesus and Mary chain, Flesh for Luluo and so many others from those soundtrack albums."

podcast.title: Pioneers of New Romanticism
podcast.body: Spandau Ballet emerged from the vibrant British club scene of Billies and The Blitz Club, which served as breeding grounds for groups associated with the New Romantic movement. This offshoot of synth-based music was characterized by its distinctive style and electronic sound. "One such offshoot was known as New Romantic, which had its roots in a couple of British clubs dedicated to new music. One was called Billies, and the other was the Blitz Club. This was the breeding site of groups like Spandovalet, Visage, and Culture Club."

xref.title: Charity Gig at 43,000 Feet (2013)
xref.body: On March 10, 2013, Tony Hadley, alongside Kim Wilde, performed a charity gig aboard a British Airways Boeing 767. The concert took place at an altitude of 43,000 feet, which is considered near the operational ceiling for most passenger jets, making it one of the highest musical performances ever. "Tony Hadley of Spandovalet and Kim Wilde, who performed a charity gig on a British Airway 767 at a height of 43,000 feet."
